route.title: Abigale
steps: Talk to Abigale in the south-east corner of Lumbridge Swamp. Dialogue: “Yes”.

route.title: Enter the manor
steps: Board the rowboat south of Abigale; it takes you to the manor.
Pick up the bucket near the fountain.
Search the barrel of rainwater north of the fountain to trigger a cutscene.
Use the bucket on the barrel of rainwater.
Search the barrel again: the manor key is at the bottom.
Enter the manor.

route.title: Puzzle 1
steps: Take the knife from the table.
Try to open the door with the pink handle.
Pick up the note that appeared.
Read the note.
Use the knife on the marked painting.
Search the painting for the ruby key.
Go through the door with the ruby handle.

route.title: Puzzle 2
steps: Search the shelves for a tinderbox.
Light all the unlit candles in the room.
Light the fuse on the barrel of gunpowder.
Leave the room to trigger the explosion.
Climb over the damaged wall.

route.title: Puzzle 3
steps: Observe Lacey through the trees.
Pick up the note by the fence.
Read the note.
Search the piano (right-click Search) for the emerald key. The tune is D-E-A-D.

route.title: Another murder
steps: Climb back over the damaged wall into the manor.
Go through the door with the green handle.
Try to enter the room containing the Bandos godsword; another murder takes place.

route.title: Puzzle 4
steps: Pick up the note by the door.
Read the note.
Use the knife on the unlit fireplace in the eastern room.
Search the fireplace and enter the stones in order: Sapphire, Diamond, Zenyte, Emerald, Onyx, Ruby.
Search the fireplace again for the sapphire key.

route.title: The murderer
steps: Go through the door with the sapphire handle.
Move the mirror to reflect the knives the murderer throws; a black swirl surrounds the wardrobe he throws from.
Watch the killer's reveal cutscene.
Pick up the killer's knife.
Equip the killer's knife, then select Fight on Abigale (no actual combat occurs).
Attempt to go through the sapphire door.
Talk to Mandy just outside the manor to complete the quest.

steps: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington. Dialogue: “I am in search of a quest” → “Yes”.

route.title: Ingredients

Pick an onion in the field north of Rimmington.

route.title: Brew the potion
steps: Bring all four ingredients to Hetty.
Drink from the cauldron in Hetty's house to finish the quest.

route.title: The lost spell
steps: Talk to Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement and accept the research package. Dialogue: “Go ahead” → “Actually, I'm not interested” → “Yes, certainly”.

route.title: Investigate the curse
steps: Talk to Ithoi in the south-western hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Gnocci in the north-west hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Arsen in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Talk to Colin in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear you've been cursed”.
Pick up the tinderbox next to Gnocci.
Take the spade in the south of Corsair Cove.
Talk to Captain Tock on the ship. Dialogue: “Arsen says he gave you a sacred ogre relic” → “About that sacred ogre relic”.
Talk to Chief Tess in the Corsair Cove Dungeon and return the relic. Dialogue: “I've come to return what Arsen stole”.
Dig next to the tree south-west of the cove to find the doll. Dialogue: “Search for the possessed doll and face the consequences”.
Go look through Ithoi's telescope.
Talk to Gnocci again in the north-west hut.
Talk to Arsen again in the central hut.
Talk to Colin again in the central hut.

route.title: Expose the traitor
steps: Talk to Captain Tock on the ship. Dialogue: “I've ruled out all the Corsairs' theories” → “So what do I do now?”.
Talk to Gnocci in the north-west hut. Dialogue: “I hear it happened straight after dinner”.
Talk to Arsen in the central hut. Dialogue: “I hear Ithoi cooked the meal you ate that night”.

Talk to Ithoi and confront him: he is not actually sick. Dialogue: “I bet I can prove you're well enough to get up” → “I know you've faked the curse” → “I hear you cooked the meal they ate before getting sick” → “Maybe because the Captain's thinking of firing you”.

Talk to Captain Tock on the ship. Dialogue: “I've seen Ithoi running around. He's not sick at all”.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree (make sure to have two empty inventory slots to start the quest). Dialogue: “You seem worried, what's up?” → “I'd be happy to help!”.

route.title: Hazelmere
steps: Go up to Hazelmere, on the island east of Yanille: on foot from Yanille (the fairy ring CLS opens only after Fairytale II, step S9-03).
Talk to Hazelmere; he takes the bark sample and gives you a message for the king.

route.title: Investigation
steps: Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree and pass on the message. Dialogue: “I think so!” → “A man came to me with the King's seal” → “I gave the man Daconia rocks” → “And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!”.
Go up to Glough in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to Glough.
Talk to King Narnode again in the Grand Tree.
Talk to Charlie on the top floor of the Grand Tree.
Return to Charlie.
Return to Glough's house and search the cupboard for Glough's journal.
Talk to Glough about his journal; you get arrested.
Talk to Charlie in the cell.
Talk to King Narnode outside Charlie's cell.
Travel with the glider (at the top of the tree) to Karamja to escape. Dialogue: “Take me to Karamja please!”.

route.title: Karamja
steps: Enter the shipyard on Karamja: say Glough sent you and give the password Ka-Lu-Min. Dialogue: “Glough sent me” → “Ka” → “Lu” → “Min”.

Get the lumber order from the Foreman on the southern docks. You can either kill him or talk to him (answer the security questions). Dialogue: “Sadly his wife is no longer with us!” → “He loves worm holes” → “Anita”.

route.title: Tuzo
steps: Talk to Anita in the house west of the Grand Tree; she gives you a key.
Search the chest in Glough's house with the key and take the invasion plans (finish the dialogue).
Take the invasion plans to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Place the twigs to spell 'TUZO' in the watchtower in Glough's house. Return to King Narnode if you lost any. If your Agility is below 25, eat a summer pie.

route.title: The black demon
steps: Go down the trapdoor. Be prepared for the fight against a Black demon (level 172).
Kill the black demon. Stand just north of the stairs and the demon gets stuck behind the rocks; use magic, ranged or a halberd for up to 10 minutes.
Talk to King Narnode deeper in the cave (finish the dialogue).
Search the roots under the Grand Tree until you find the last daconia rock. If you lose the rock, it will be in the same root again.
Give the daconia rock to King Narnode under the Grand Tree to finish the quest.

Kill the Temple Guardian (level 30) in the dungeon. It is immune to magic, so use ranged or melee.
Return to King Roald. Dialogue: “About that job I'm doing”.

route.title: Return to the temple
steps: Return to the temple (bring a bucket and 50 rune or pure essence).
Kill a Monk of Zamorak (level 30) for a golden key. You can safespot using the pews.
Talk to Drezel on the top floor of the temple (he is locked in a cell). Dialogue: “So, what now?” → “Yes, of course”.

Go back up to the top floor of the temple (with the water).

Talk to Drezel to bless the water.
Use the blessed water on the coffin in the same room and leave when Drezel appears.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Dialogue: “Yes”.

route.title: Inspect the shipyard
steps: Fly with Captain Errdo to Gandius.
Talk to G.L.O. Caranock in the shipyard.
Return to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

route.title: Sail to Ape Atoll
steps: Talk to Daero on the 1st floor of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Make sure to go through all of the chat options until you are given a 'Leave...' option. Dialogue: “Leave” → “Who is it?” → “Yes” → “Talk about the 10th squad”.
Talk to Daero in the hangar.
Operate the reinitialisation panel and solve the puzzle.
Talk to Daero in the hangar again.
Talk to Waydar. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Talk to Lumdo.
Talk to Waydar on Crash Island. Dialogue: “I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island”.

route.title: Find Garkor
steps: Head west and enter the valley going north WITH PROTECT FROM RANGED ON. Be wary of poison and taking damage.
Wait for the gorilla guard to start going away from the prison cell, then sneak out and go to the north side of the prison.
Stick to the east edge of the town, and make your way to Garkor to the south-east.

route.title: Amulet parts
steps: Head west and enter the large open building via the south door. DO NOT STAND ON THE LIGHT FLOOR IN THE BUILDING.
DO NOT WALK ON THE LIGHT FLOOR. Search the stacked crates for monkey dentures. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Search the crate in the south-east corner and go down into the cavern. Dialogue: “Yes, I'm sure”.
Search the crate in the north-west of the room for an M'amulet mould. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Teleport out to prepare for a dangerous portion. You'll want energy/stamina potions, food and prayer potions.

route.title: Enchanted bar
steps: Get food, antipoison, energy/stamina/prayer potions, and return to Ape Atoll.
Enter the dungeon in south Ape Atoll.
Talk to Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. Dialogue: “What do we need for the monkey amulet?” → “I'll be back later”.
Use the monkey dentures on Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. If you've already done so, open the quest journal to re-sync your current state.
Use the M'amulet mould on Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. If you've already done so, open the quest journal to re-sync your current state.
Use the gold bar on Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. If you've already done so, open the quest journal to re-sync your current state.

route.title: Make the amulet
steps: Teleport out to prepare to make the amulet. You'll want some food, prayer potions, antipoisons, the mould and the enchanted bar.
Get food, antipoison, prayer potions, and return to Ape Atoll.
Head west and enter the valley going north WITH PROTECT FROM RANGED ON. Be wary of poison and taking damage.
Wait for the gorilla guard to start going away from the prison cell, then sneak out and go to the north side of the prison. Afterwards, head into the temple's basement.
Use the enchanted bar on the wall of flame.

route.title: Talisman
steps: Climb the rope out. If you plan on doing Recipe for Disaster, also kill a zombie monkey for its bones whilst here, and a gorilla upstairs.

Go to the north-west of the island and talk to the monkey child there a few times. Eventually you'll give him 5 bananas, and he'll give you a monkey talisman. Dialogue: “Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!” → “How many bananas did Aunty want?” → “Ok, I promise!” → “I've lost that toy you gave me” → “Wow - can I borrow it?”.
Talk to the monkey child again.
Talk to the monkey child again.
Give the monkey child 5 bananas.
Wait for the aunt to make another round, then talk to the monkey child for the talisman.

route.title: Bones for RFD (optional)
steps: This section will help you get ready for Recipe for Disaster. If you aren't interested in this, tick the box for this section in the sidebar to skip it. Dialogue: “I've lost that toy you gave me” → “Wow - can I borrow it?” → “Ok, I promise!”.
Kill a monkey archer for its bones.
Kill a gorilla in the temple for its bones. If it can attack you it heals on hit, so it's recommended to safespot or flinch one.
Enter the temple's basement to kill a zombie monkey for its bones.
Kill a zombie monkey for its bones.

route.title: Make the greegree
steps: Teleport out to prepare to make the talisman. You'll want some food, prayer potions and antipoisons.
Get food, antipoison, prayer potions, and return to Ape Atoll.
Enter the dungeon in south Ape Atoll.
Use the monkey talisman on Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. If you've already done so, open the quest journal to re-sync your current state.
Use the monkey bones on Zooknock in the north-east of the dungeon. If you've already done so, open the quest journal to re-sync your current state.

If you want to make a zombie, ninja and gorilla greegree for RFD, talk to and give Zooknock the bones/talismans. Once you're done, teleport away for the next step. Dialogue: “Can you make another monkey talisman?” → “Yes”.

route.title: Rescue the monkey
steps: Talk to the Monkey Minder in the Ardougne Zoo whilst wielding the Karamjan monkey greegree.
Talk to a monkey in the pen.
UNEQUIP the greegree, then talk to the Monkey Minder again to leave.
WALK/RUN to Daero to return to Ape Atoll. If you teleport, you'll have to start again.
Talk to Garkor.
Talk to a guard outside the building in the south-east of Marim. If you already have, open the quest journal to re-sync.
Talk to Kruk in the north-west of the island.
Talk to Awowogei twice.
Talk to Garkor.

route.title: Defeat the demon
steps: Prepare to fight the Jungle Demon. Once you're ready, equip the 10th squad sigil.
Kill the Jungle Demon. Use Protect from Magic and keep your distance to kill it safely.
Return to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold to finish the quest.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Needs 32 quest points. Dialogue: “Can I have a quest?”.

Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville. Dialogue: “Can you sell me a rune platebody?” → “The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.” → “I thought you were going to give me a quest.” → “A dragon, that sounds like fun.”.

route.title: The Guildmaster's questions
steps: Return to the Guildmaster and ask every question in turn: the ship, the shield, Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's map pieces. Asking about Melzar's piece gives you the Maze key.

do.t: Bring Ned the Crandor map and ask him to be your captain. Dialogue: “You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?”.
do.s: Captain Ned (Draynor): ask him to be your captain

items.name: Map part
items.where: The three map pieces: Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's (S5-03 to S5-05).

route.title: Sail to Crandor
steps: Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, food and a strong weapon.
Board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim and talk to Ned on the deck.

route.title: Crandor and the volcano
steps: Go to the centre of the island and down the hole.
Go all the way south and through the wall: it unlocks the shortcut from the Karamja volcano.
Enter Elvarg's area and kill her. Her head ends up in your bag.

do.t: Prepare to fight Elvarg (level 83). Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, plenty of food (lobsters or swordfish), a strong weapon (adamant or rune) and a strength potion. Then board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
do.s: Port Sarim: board the ship (Anti-dragon shield in the bag first!)

pre.t: Get the Anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle

do.t: Talk to Ned on the deck. Dialogue: “Yes, let's go!”.
do.s: Ship deck: talk to Ned to sail to Crandor

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn before the fight: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70. Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle gives it free (S5-02).

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: bring 20 or more (swordfish are as good).

items.name: Strength potion(4)
items.where: Optional boost: a strength potion before the fight.

do.t: Go to the centre of the island and go down the hole.
do.s: Crandor: climb down the hole in the centre of the island

do.t: Go all the way south and through the wall to unlock the shortcut back to the Karamja volcano. Lesser demons (level 82) can attack down here: keep moving and eat when low. If you die later, come back through the volcano at Karamja (south of Brimhaven) and through this wall.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: go south and through the wall (shortcut)

do.t: Equip the Anti-dragon shield, then climb into Elvarg's area. Pick the Stab style on the sword, eat below 20 health, and never take the shield off.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: enter Elvarg's lair (shield worn!)

do.t: Kill Elvarg (level 83). When she dies her head lands in your inventory.
do.s: Elvarg's lair: kill Elvarg (her head drops into the bag)

go.label: Crandor — the hole in the centre of the island

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70.

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: 20 or more.

route.title: Finish
steps: Talk to Oziach in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest.

do.t: Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest. Then you can buy and wear the Rune platebody (Defence 40).
do.s: Oziach (Edgeville): finish the quest
